function: p. 5-8: RISnet, a permutation-invariant neural network, maps channel features and user weights to RIS phase shifts; BS precoding is analytical WMMSE; objective is weighted sum rate.
system: p. 3-4, 9: Multi-user MISO downlink, 9 BS antennas, 4 single-antenna users, passive reflecting 36x36 RIS (16 anchor elements estimate CSI) with mutual coupling, 3.5 GHz.
method: p. 5-9: RISnet, a specialized GNN-like NN with shared per-element processing units; unsupervised training by gradient ascent on weighted sum rate with Adam; alternating optimization with WMMSE precoding.
data_channel: p. 9: DeepMIMO ray-tracing urban intersection channels at 3.5 GHz, plus variants with i.i.d. scattering gain and fully i.i.d. channel; 10,240 training and 1,024 testing samples.
test_conditions: p. 9-11: Test samples generated independently from training samples under the same setup; model trained without mutual coupling is also tested with mutual coupling (Fig. 10).
baselines: p. 10: Non-learned random phase shift and BCD [6]; learned DRL with fully connected network [21]; baselines assume full CSI and no mutual coupling.
metrics: p. 9-11: Weighted sum rate (WSR, bit/Hz/s) in training, testing and against baselines; inference time of the RIS configuration.
complexity: p. 11-12: Inference O(QPKN), linear in RIS elements N (BCD O(U^2N^2), fully connected NN O(UN^2)); 1296 elements in 0.07 s on a laptop; about 10^4 parameters.
openness: p. 12: Code and data at github.com/bilepeng/risnet_mutual_partial; DeepMIMO open-source dataset (p. 9).
q1_support: p. 9: "The open-source DeepMIMO data set [38] is applied to generate channel data"
q2_support: p. 11: "testing RISnet trained without mutual coupling to problem with mutual coupling"
q3_support: p. 10: "use deep reinforcement learning (DRL) [21], random phase shift, and BCD algorithm [6] as baselines for comparison"; p. 10: "Figure 9 shows the performance comparison of the proposed approach and the baselines"
q4_support: p. 11: "Asymptotically, the complexity of RISnet inference is O(QP KN )"; p. 11: "RISnet can configure a RIS with 1296 elements within 0.07 second"
q5_support: p. 12: "Code and data in this paper are available under github.com/bilepeng/risnet_mutual_partial"
notes: Area 3: the learned part is the RIS configuration; BS precoding is analytical WMMSE applied by alternating optimization (p. 8), so the work is not excluded for mixing learned and analytical parts. Three channel variants are used (p. 9): DeepMIMO ray tracing, DeepMIMO plus i.i.d. scattering gain, and a fully i.i.d. channel; q1 rests on the DeepMIMO ray-tracing case. q2 rests on the mutual-coupling mismatch test (p. 11, large loss reported for partial CSI); all other tests use held-out samples of the same setup (p. 9). The baselines are compared without mutual coupling and with full CSI (p. 10). The mutual-coupling matrix S_II comes from ref. [30] (p. 4).
